blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Current 3D generation methods lack explicit local control: geometric adherence is often defined by a global control strength, and appearance cannot be specified locally. We present SpaceFlow, a training-free pipeline for locally controllable 3D generation from text descriptions and a collection of geometric primitives. Each primitive serves as a proxy for an object part and is assigned a local control level, enabling users to specify whether regions should strictly follow the input shape or allow generative completion. During structure generation, we enforce these spatial constraints within the generative flow process. For appearance synthesis, the generated structure is segmented and matched to the primitives. Each generated part is conditioned only on its assigned text or image cue, thereby limiting cross-part leakage. Regional geometry metrics demonstrate that SpaceFlow preserves the specified geometry in high-control regions and enables plausible shape variation in low-control areas. A user study further indicates that the resulting balance between geometric fidelity and generative freedom remains competitive in overall quality. When evaluating appearance on fixed geometry, text-conditioned routing achieves state-of-the-art prompt faithfulness and color/material accuracy. Qualitative results additionally show localized routing of image cues. The project page is available at SpaceFlow3D.github.io.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent text- and image-conditioned 3D generative models can synthesize high-quality textured assets across increasingly diverse object categories [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] . These advances dramatically lower the barrier from a visual idea or reference to an initial 3D candidate asset, with applications in games, immersive media, and digital content creation [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] .
Although the quality of assets generated from a single image or text prompt continues to improve, integrating such generators into artistic workflows requires more interactive and controllable guidance mechanisms [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh:
最近具有文字和图像条件的3D基因模型可以将高质量的有纹理的资产合成日益多样化的对象类别[1、2、3、4、5、6、7、8]。 这些进步大大降低了障碍,从视觉概念或提及最初的3D候选资产,在游戏,浸入媒体,数字内容创建[9,10,11,12,13]中都有应用.
虽然单一图像或文字提示产生的资产质量继续提高,但将这种发电机纳入艺术工作流程需要更具互动性和可控制的指导机制[14、15、16、17]。

blocks.en:
In practice, asset creation is iterative [ 18 , 19 ] and part-specific [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] , rather than one-shot: creators establish coarse structure, inspect generated candidates, retain some design decisions, and revise others [ 25 ] . Some parts may have to follow an intended shape, whereas others are left under-constrained, relying on the generative prior [ 26 ] .
Supporting this process requires control not only over what is generated, but also over where each instruction applies and how strictly it should be followed [ 20 , 27 , 28 ] .
blocks.zh:
在实践中,资产创造是迭接[18,19]和部分特定[20,21,22,23,24],而不是一发:创造者建立粗糙的结构,检查生成的候选人,保留一些设计决定,并修改其他[25]. 某些部分可能必须遵循预定形状,而另一些部分则受到不足的制约,依赖于前[26].
支持这一进程不仅需要控制产生的内容,而且需要控制每项指令在何地适用,以及应如何严格遵循[20、27、28]。

blocks.en: To support this need, recent methods augment general-purpose 3D generators [ 29 , 3 ] with controllable geometric or appearance guidance [ 28 , 30 ] . On one hand, proxy-guided approaches [ 28 , 31 ] enable geometric conditioning by guiding 3D generation with an input 3D shape. However, they apply this conditioning globally , such that all regions are equally constrained by the input geometry. On the other hand, other approaches introduce test-time, part-aware guidance for appearance transfer [ 30 ] or localized editing of implicit representations [ 32 ] , while leaving geometry generation unconstrained or operating post-hoc on pre-existing representations. Appearance guidance is also limited to a single global condition, preventing different cues from being assigned to different regions. Existing approaches therefore lack a unified mechanism for local control over both geometry and appearance.
blocks.zh: 为支持这一需要,最近的方法增加了通用三维发电机[29,3],增加了可控几何或外观取向[28,30]。 一方面,代用制导方法[28,31]通过以输入式3D外形来引导3D生成来进行几何调节. 然而,它们在全球应用这一条件,使所有区域同样受到输入几何的制约。 另一方面,其他方法引入了测试时间,部分意识的外观转移指导[30]或对隐含表示的本地化编辑[32],同时使几何生成不受约束,或运行在先前存在的表示上. 外观指导也仅限于一个单一的全球条件,防止将不同的提示分配给不同的区域. 因此,现有的方法缺乏一个统一的机制,无法在当地控制几何和外观。

blocks.en: We propose SpaceFlow , a unified approach for local control of both geometry and appearance during 3D generation, as shown in Fig. 1 . In practice, the user specifies the geometry and scene layout as an explicit geometric input, decomposed into an arbitrary set of local parts that can be addressed independently. For geometric conditioning, we assign a local control level to each part: higher levels enforce closer adherence to the specified geometry, whereas lower levels leave more freedom to the generative prior. The formulation is agnostic to how individual parts are represented, ranging from coarse geometric primitives to detailed meshes. Following [ 28 ] , we represent parts as superquadric primitives [ 33 ] , which provide a compact, expressive, and easily editable representation. These can either be defined manually or initialized from existing geometry using shape decomposition methods [ 34 , 35 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们提出SpaceFlow(SpaceFlow),在3D生成期间对几何和外观进行局部控制的统一方法,如图一所示. 在实际操作中,用户将几何和场景布局指定为明确的几何输入,分解为一组可以独立处理的任意局部部分. 就几何条件而言,我们为每一部分指定一个局部控制级别:更高水平强制更紧密地遵守指定的几何,而较低水平则给先基因留下了更多的自由. 配体是不可知的,从粗糙的几何原始物到详细的网状物,到单个部分是如何被表示的. 在[28]之后,我们代表部分为超夸张原始人[33],这些原始人提供了紧凑的,表达的,易于编辑的代表. 这些可以手动定义,也可以从现有的几何学上用形状分解方法初始化[34,35].

blocks.en: We use the same part decomposition for appearance conditioning. Specifically, the user can assign a distinct appearance condition to each part, allowing different regions to be controlled independently. We achieve this by restricting cross-attention to the condition associated with each part, while retaining global self-attention across all tokens. This enables distinct local appearances while preserving coherence and smooth blending across the generated asset.
blocks.zh: 我们用相同的部分去分解外观 具体而言,用户可以给每个部分指定一个不同的外观条件,允许不同区域独立控制. 我们实现这一目标的方式是限制对每一部分相关条件的交叉关注,同时保持全球对所有标志的自觉。 这可以使当地出现不同样貌,同时保持一致性并平稳地混合所生成的资产。

blocks.en: We evaluate the geometric and appearance components separately and demonstrate their combined capabilities on diverse multipart assets. Regional geometry metrics show that SpaceFlow preserves strongly constrained regions more faithfully than weak global conditioning, while allowing greater variation in weakly constrained regions than strong global conditioning. A user study further supports this balance between geometric fidelity and generative freedom. On fixed geometry, our VLM-as-a-judge evaluation of localized text-conditioned appearance shows higher prompt faithfulness and color/material accuracy than the evaluated TRELLIS and GuideFlow3D variants [ 3 , 30 ] . We additionally demonstrate localized image-conditioned appearance through qualitative results.
blocks.zh: 我们分别评价几何和外观部分,并显示它们在多种多部分资产方面的综合能力。 区域几何测量指标显示,SpaceFlow保存了较弱的全球条件更忠实地保存了受到强烈制约的区域,同时允许受弱制约区域的差异大于强有力的全球条件。 一项用户研究进一步支持了几何忠诚与基因自由之间的平衡. 在固定几何方面,我们对本地文本条件外观的VLM-as-a-judge评价显示,与评价的TRELLIS和GuideFlow3D变体[3,30]相比,其迅速的忠诚度和颜色/材料准确度更高. 此外,我们通过质量结果,还展示了地方形象化的外观。

blocks.en: In summary, our technical contributions are: • An approach to locally control the strength of geometric conditioning for 3D generation. • An approach to locally condition the appearance of generated 3D assets. • A unified framework combining both approaches to enable local geometric and appearance control for 3D generation.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的技术贡献是: 用于3D生成的几何调节强度的局部控制方法 。 以当地方式对生成的三维资产的外观作出条件。 • 将两种方法结合起来的统一框架,以便能够对3D生成进行局部几何和外观控制。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 3D Asset Generation. Generative 3D modeling has advanced rapidly in output fidelity and representation flexibility, from explicit point clouds [ 36 ] and implicit functions [ 7 ] to compact latent-space approaches [ 37 , 38 , 39 ] . Recently, large-scale generators have achieved strong fidelity: CLAY [ 1 ] leverages multi-resolution latent spaces, Hunyuan3D [ 2 ] scales diffusion for high-resolution textured assets, SAM 3D [ 29 ] enables single-image 3D reconstruction, and TRELLIS [ 3 ] introduces structured latents factoring geometry and appearance on a sparse voxel grid. However, these models condition on a global text or image prompt and lack fine-grained, localized part control.
blocks.zh: 三维"资产生成". 基因三维模型在输出忠诚度和代表性灵活性方面迅速取得进展,从明确的点云[36]和隐含的函数[7]到紧凑的潜在空间方法[37、38、39]。 最近,大型发电机实现了强烈的忠诚:CLAY [1] 利用多分辨率潜入空间,Hunyuan3D [2] 为高分辨率有纹理资产传播天平,SAM 3D [29] 实现单相相相3D重建,而TRELLIS [3] 引入了结构化潜入因素,将几何学和外观带入一个稀疏的花纹网格. 然而,这些模型以全局文本或图像为条件,并缺乏精细的局部部分控制.

blocks.en: Spatially Controllable 3D Generation. Spatially controllable generation conditions on explicit 3D inputs, such as voxels, primitives, proxy shapes, or meshes, rather than ambiguous text or images [ 39 , 40 , 41 , 28 ] . Existing frameworks either fine-tune generative models to accept structural conditions [ 31 , 41 , 42 ] at additional training cost, or enforce test-time constraints via optimization and latent projection [ 40 , 28 ] without retraining. Closest to our structural setting, SpaceControl [ 28 ] injects user-specified geometry into a pretrained generator’s latent space with a control strength that trades geometric fidelity for generative realism. However, since this trade-off is applied uniformly across the entire asset, it cannot handle scenarios where designated regions must strictly preserve input geometry while others are left unconstrained for generative completion [ 28 ] .

blocks.en:
Appearance Control for 3D Assets. Appearance control has been widely explored across mesh texturing [ 43 , 44 , 45 , 46 , 47 ] , radiance fields, and 3D Gaussian splats [ 48 , 49 , 50 ] . These methods primarily formulate appearance control as post-hoc texturing or stylization of an existing 3D asset, whereas our focus is localized appearance conditioning during the generative flow process [ 43 , 44 , 48 , 49 ] .
GuideFlow3D [ 30 ] provided training-free guidance of a pretrained rectified-flow model using a self-similarity loss for robust appearance transfer. However, it transfers a single appearance source globally across the generated asset. In contrast, SpaceFlow routes independent visual conditions to specific semantic parts, eliminating cross-part leakage.
blocks.zh:

GuideFlow3D [30] 提供了无培训指导,即使用自我相似性损失来进行稳健外观转换,对经过预先训练的矫正流程模型进行无培训指导。 然而,它将一个单一的外观来源传入全球所有产生的资产。 相形之下,SpaceFlow路线独立地将视觉条件通向特定的语义部分,消除了跨段的渗出.

blocks.en: Part-Aware Generation and Editing. A complementary line of work introduces part-aware generators, which incorporate explicit part structure through hierarchical graphs and programs [ 21 , 24 ] , implicit or radiance-field representations, and diffusion over point or latent spaces [ 22 , 51 , 23 , 26 ] , including recent part-level reconstruction and synthesis methods [ 20 , 42 , 52 , 53 , 54 ] . In contrast, SpaceFlow does not require the generated asset to be represented as parts; it uses primitives and part assignments only as localized control signals for a pretrained generator.

blocks.zh: 3.2 初步情况

blocks.en: TRELLIS [ 3 ] is a pretrained 3D generator based on structured latents (SLAT), which attach local feature vectors to the active voxels of a sparse 3D grid. It generates assets in two stages using rectified flow transformers: first establishing the coarse sparse voxel structure, and then synthesizing the local geometry and appearance latents on the active voxels. Finally, different decoders are applied to map SLAT to diverse 3D representations [ 56 , 57 , 58 ] of high quality.

blocks.en: SpaceControl [ 28 ] is a training-free method built on TRELLIS that enables conditioning asset generation on geometric inputs. Given a user-specified geometric control input 𝒮 \mathcal{S} (primitives or meshes), it encodes the geometry into the structure latent space via TRELLIS’s pretrained VAE encoder to obtain a clean latent 𝐳 1 \mathbf{z}_{1} . Instead of sampling from pure Gaussian noise, SpaceControl perturbs 𝐳 1 \mathbf{z}_{1} to an intermediate flow timestep τ \tau , producing a partially noisy latent 𝐳 τ \mathbf{z}_{\tau} , and starts denoising from this state. blocks.en: To complement our quantitative evaluation, we conducted a pairwise user study assessing the perceptual quality of the generated assets. We compared SpaceFlow against SpaceControl baselines under uniform guidance ( τ = 3 \tau\!=\!3 and τ = 10 \tau\!=\!10 ). For each scene, three variants ( SpaceFlow , τ = 3 \tau\!=\!3 , and τ = 10 \tau\!=\!10 ) were generated from identical text prompts and superquadric inputs. Participants inspected interactive 3D model pairs side-by-side and evaluated them based on shape fidelity, realism, and overall preference, yielding a total of 337 trials across 29 evaluators.
blocks.zh: 为了补充我们的定量评价,我们进行了双向用户研究,评估所生成资产的认知质量。 我们在统一指引下将SpaceFlow与SpaceControl基线进行比较(\\=3\tau\!3和\=10\tau\!10),对于每个场景,有三个变体(SpaceFlow,\\=3\tau\!!!3,和\=10\tau\!10)都是由相同的文本提示和超方位输入生成的. 与会者逐一检查了互动的三维模型对子,并根据形状忠诚、现实主义和总体偏好对其进行了评价,共对29名评价人员进行了337次试验。

Overall, the study shows that local control avoids the rigid trade-off of uniform global guidance while maintaining overall quality.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced SpaceFlow , an inference-time framework for localized geometry and appearance control in 3D asset generation. Editable geometric inputs define the controlled regions, each associated with a geometric control level and a text or image appearance cue. During structure generation, the control levels modulate spatial guidance, allowing constrained regions to follow the input geometry more closely while leaving others unconstrained, relying on the generative prior. During appearance synthesis, the framework matches the input regions to generated parts and routes each cue only to its corresponding part, supporting localized conditioning while limiting cross-part leakage.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了SpaceFlow, 一个三维资产生成中本地化几何和外观控制的推断时间框架。 可编辑的几何输入定义了被控制区域,每个区域都与几何控制级别和文本或图像外观提示相关. 在结构生成过程中,控制级别会调节空间取向,允许受约束区域更紧密地跟随输入几何,同时让其他人不受约束,依赖先入后出. 在外观合成过程中,框架将输入区与生成的部件和路由相匹配,每个出入口只通向相应的部分,支持局部调节,同时限制跨段渗出.

blocks.en: Evaluations combining vision-language judge assessments, user studies, and regional metrics demonstrate that SpaceFlow successfully overcomes the limitations of uniform global guidance, enabling localized geometric control. Furthermore, localized appearance routing consistently outperforms existing unrouted baselines in prompt faithfulness. Overall, SpaceFlow enables users to specify not only what to generate, but precisely where each spatial constraint and appearance cue should apply.
blocks.zh: 结合视觉语法官评估、用户研究和区域衡量标准进行的评价表明,SpaceFlow成功地克服了统一全球指导的局限性,实现了局部几何控制。 此外,局部外观路线在迅速忠实的情况下,一贯超过现有无路线基线。 总体而言,SpaceFlow使用户不仅能够具体说明产生什么,而且能够确切地说明每个空间约束和外观提示应适用何处。

blocks.en: We constructed a dataset of 83 83 3D assets covering diverse object categories. Each asset is defined by superquadric primitives with designated high-control and low-control regions, alongside local appearance prompts a i a_{i} .
blocks.zh: 我们构建了83个83个三维资产的数据集,涵盖不同的对象类别。 每一个资产都由具有指定高控制和低控制区域的超等原始人定义,而本地外观则催生出一个i a_{i}.

blocks.en: The benchmark combines manually authored configurations designed to reflect realistic use cases with assets generated via a semi-automated pipeline in which an LLM ( ChatGPT 5.6 Sol ) proposed candidate primitive layouts, local control assignments, and appearance cues. All assets were validated and, if needed, refined by human annotators. The validation criteria were the following:
blocks.zh: 该基准将人工授权的配置结合起来,旨在反映现实的使用案例和通过半自动管道生成的资产,其中LLM(ChatGPT 5.6 Sol)提出了候选原始布局,局部控制任务和外观提示. 所有资产都经过验证,必要时由人名注释员加以改进。 审定标准如下:

blocks.en:
(i) meaningful control contrast , ensuring high-control regions specify well-defined structural elements while low-control regions remain intentionally coarse to test generative completion rather than trivial generation.
(ii) spatial validity , confirming that low-control primitives are not geometrically contained by high-control ones.
(iii) appearance fidelity , verifying that per-part appearance prompts are coherent, unambiguous, and accurately mapped to target primitives.
blocks.zh:
(一) 有意义的控制对比,确保高控制区域规定明确的结构要素,而低控制区域仍故意粗糙地测试基因完成情况,而不是微不足道的生成。
(二) 空间有效性,确认低控制原始物不是由高控制原始物所控制的几何。
(三) 外观忠贞 核实逐一外观的提示是一致的,毫不含糊的,准确的映射到目标原始人.

blocks.en: Appendix S5 Vision-Language-Model Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录S5 远景-语言-模式 评价

blocks.en: We evaluate localized geometric structure control and appearance generation using vision-language-model judges ( GPT-5.6 Sol ). Each evaluation instance presents the judge with two fixed views of a generated asset ( ∼ 210 ∘ \sim 210^{\circ} apart) alongside the corresponding input conditions (superquadric proxies or text/image references). All evaluations are blinded: judges receive no method identifiers, filenames, or cross-sample scores.
blocks.zh: 我们利用视觉语言模型法官(GPT-5.6 Sol)来评价局部几何结构控制和外观生成。 每个评审案例向法官提供对所生成资产的两个固定观点(相隔于\210\sim 210\sirc}),以及相应的输入条件(超等代词或文本/图像参考). 所有评价都是盲目的:法官没有获得方法识别符,文件名,或者交叉抽样分数.

blocks.en: For reproducibility, we detail below the exact prompts, rendering procedures, inference parameters used across our structure and appearance evaluations.
blocks.zh: 关于可复制性,我们在下面详细列出整个结构和外观评价中使用的确切提示、程序、推论参数。

blocks.en: S5.1 Structure Control Evaluation
blocks.zh: S5.1 结构控制评价

blocks.en: To isolate geometric control from appearance quality, we render the generated assets as untextured shapes at the same scale and alignment as the input superquadrics. This prevents appearance quality from masking geometric defects.
blocks.zh: 为了将几何控制与外观质量隔离开来,我们使所生成的资产成为与输入超正方体规模和对齐的无文字形状. 这防止了外观质量掩盖几何缺陷.

blocks.en: The judge is presented with the input control shape, where region colors provide control-level labels: • Orange (High Control, τ = 10 \tau=10 ): The output geometry must strictly preserve the shape, proportions, and placement of these primitives. • White/Gray (Weak Control, τ = 3 \tau=3 ): The generator is expected to rely on the generative prior to generate a plausible geometry that matches the text prompt.
blocks.zh: 评委呈现出输入控制形状,其中区域颜色提供控制级别标签: • Orange(高控制,\\ tau=10): 输出几何必须严格保存这些原始物的形状,比例和位置. • 白色/灰色(微弱控制,\\\ tau=3): 生成器在生成与文本提示相匹配的几何图形之前,预计将依赖基因。

blocks.en: Pairwise Evaluation. We conduct head-to-head comparisons across all 83 dataset assets between SpaceFlow (local guidance with τ = 10 \tau=10 in high-control and τ = 3 \tau=3 in low-control regions) and SpaceControl uniform guidance baselines ( τ = 3 \tau=3 and τ = 10 \tau=10 ). The judge evaluates control and prompt adherence, realism, and overall preference. The exact prompt layout and instructions are detailed in Fig. S15 .

blocks.en: S5.2 Appearance Evaluation: Pairwise Evaluation
blocks.zh: S5.2 外观评价:对等评价

blocks.en: For text-guided texture synthesis, we perform pairwise comparisons between SpaceFlow (part-level condition routing) and appearance baselines (TRELLIS [ 3 ] and GuideFlow3D [ 30 ] ). All methods generate textures on identical base geometry generated with SpaceFlow to strictly isolate appearance generation. The complete pairwise appearance instructions are shown in Fig. S16 .

Orange input primitives denote high control and gray input primitives denote low control. Lower values permit greater prompt-driven geometric freedom, whereas increasing τ low \tau_{\mathrm{low}} progressively strengthens adherence to the input geometry. Outputs are shown without texture to isolate geometric behavior.
blocks.zh: 图S7:定性局部控制强度连续. 我们把保护原始物固定在 = 10\tau\ mathrm{ high\ 10\ 10\ 上,并将可编辑区域强度改变在 {1, 3, 5, 7, 9}\tau\ mathrm{ low\\ in 1, 3, 5, 7, 9} 上。 橙色输入原始表示高控制,而灰色输入原始表示低控制. 更低的值允许更快速地驱动几何自由,而增加 \ tau\ mathrm{ low} 则逐步加强对输入几何的遵守 。 输出显示时没有纹理来隔离几何行为.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. S6 , a lower τ low \tau_{\mathrm{low}} gives the generator substantial freedom to deviate from the input primitives, while increasing τ low \tau_{\mathrm{low}} progressively constrains the shape to the input geometry until both curves converge at τ low ≈ τ high \tau_{\mathrm{low}}\approx\tau_{\mathrm{high}} . Notably, deviation in the high-control regions also decreases slightly as τ low \tau_{\mathrm{low}} increases, despite τ high \tau_{\mathrm{high}} being held constant. This reflects the global nature of the generative flow backbone: large shape modifications in low-control regions exert a slight geometric pull across part boundaries onto neighboring high-control regions.
blocks.zh: 如图S6所示,一个更低的\tau_{\mathrm{low} 使生成器有很大的自由偏离输入原始,同时增加 \tau_{\mathrm{low} 将形状逐渐限制在输入几何上,直到两道曲线相会于 \ tau_{\mathrm{ low}相会于\ tau_{\mathrm{ high} 。 值得注意的是,高控制区域的偏差也随着\ tau\ mathrm{ low} 的增加而略有减少, 尽管\ tau\ mathrm{ high} 保持不变。 这反映了基因流主干线的全球性质:低控制区域大变形将略微几何拉出部分边界到相邻的高控制区域.

blocks.en: Additionally, the higher mean and variance observed in the high-control region at low τ low \tau_{\mathrm{low}} are partly due to a boundary effect of our metric definition. Under low control, the model can freely generate novel parts that may emerge near the boundary between regions. Because mesh faces are partitioned according to their nearest input primitive, some of these newly generated structures may be mapped to adjacent high-control primitives despite having no counterpart in the geometric input, thereby increasing the regional Chamfer distance. As τ low \tau_{\mathrm{low}} increases, unconstrained generation is reduced, lowering both the metric mean and variance.
blocks.zh: 此外,在高控制区观察到的较高平均值和差异值在低\\ tau\ mathrm{ low} 部分是由于我们的度量定义的边界效应。 在低控制下,该模型可以自由产生可能出现在相邻区域边界附近的新颖部件. 因为网面被按照最近的输入原始进行分出,所以尽管几何输入中没有对应物,这些新产生的结构中有些可能被映射到相邻的高控制原始地上,从而增加了区域Chamfer相距. 由于 \ tau\ mathrm{ low} 的增加, 未受约束的生成会减少, 既降低公制平均值, 也降低差异 。

blocks.en: Fig. S7 illustrates this behavior for two representative inputs. At low τ low \tau_{\mathrm{low}} , the model has greater freedom to reinterpret the geometric input according to the prompt. At higher values, the output increasingly follows the input geometry, providing a continuous transition from prompt-driven generation to geometric fidelity.

blocks.en: Appendix S8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录S8 限制

blocks.en: Semantic-Geometric Conflicts. A primary failure mode in our geometric control module occurs when the text prompt contradicts the input geometry (e.g. , requesting a “standing person” over a “bench” structure). In such cases, the text-conditioning pathway attempts to generate human features while the geometric guidance enforces the shape of the high-control regions. Because the underlying generator lacks a joint prior for geometric and textual combinations, the model struggles to reconcile both signals. This typically results in unnatural geometric distortions as the model attempts to synthesize the text-described asset around the constrained high-control regions (see Fig. S10 ).
blocks.zh: 语义-几何冲突. 在我们的几何控制模块中,当文字提示与输入几何相矛盾时(例如,要求一个“站立人”凌驾于“站立”结构之上),就会发生主故障模式。 在这种情况下,文本调节路径试图产生人文特征,而几何取向则强制实施高控制区域的形状. 由于基础生成器缺乏几何和文字组合的连接前置,模型在调和两个信号上都挣扎. 这通常造成非自然几何扭曲,因为模型试图在受限制的高控制区域周围合成文字描述的资产(见图S10)。

blocks.en: Figure S10 : Semantic-geometric conflict. Synthesizing a “person” over an input “bench” structure (left). Lacking a joint prior for conflicting modalities, the model generates unnatural distortions by embedding the bench’s high-control geometry inside the generated “person” (right).
blocks.zh: 图S10:语义-几何冲突. 以输入“下”结构合成“人”(左)。 该模型缺乏冲突模式的共同前置性,在生成的"人"(右)中嵌入了长椅的高控制几何,从而产生非自然的扭曲.

blocks.en:
Misrouted Appearance Cues. Our appearance module inherits the granularity of the underlying part
decomposition: the routing volume is derived from PartField clusters in 32 3 32^{3} voxel space, and each cluster is assigned to a single appearance
condition. When a cluster boundary does not coincide with the true
material boundary of the generated asset, the corresponding appearance
cue is applied to the wrong voxels, and the error is directly visible in
the final texture. Fig. S11 shows two representative
cases. In the frying pan, the routing volume assigns the pan body and
the handle to different conditions, but a thin band of handle voxels
leaks along the rim; the wooden handle appearance consequently bleeds
onto the metal body. In the chair, the seat cluster does not fully cover
the cushion surface, so only part of the seat receives the intended
upholstery condition while the remaining voxels are textured by the
competing condition, yielding a visibly discontinuous seat. Both
failures are localized to the routing stage rather than the generator:
the geometry is faithful to the input primitives, and only the
region-to-condition assignment is incorrect. Finer part decompositions
or soft, distance-weighted routing boundaries are a natural direction
for mitigating this effect.

blocks.zh: 图S16:对等外观评价的快速模板。 在相同的几何上盲目地比较纹理输出,以衡量迅速的忠诚度和地表质量。

blocks.en: Figure S17 : Prompt template for text-conditioned standalone VLM evaluation. Complete system instructions and input layout used to score part-wise text appearance generation.
blocks.zh: 图S17:文字条件独立VLM评价的快速模板. 完整系统指令和输入布局,用于分分部分的文本外观生成.

blocks.en: Figure S18 : Prompt template for image-conditioned standalone VLM evaluation. Layout provided to the VLM judge to score local reference image style transfer and spatial routing accuracy.
blocks.zh: 图S18:图像条件下的独立VLM评价的快速模板. 向VLM评委提供布局,以评分本地参考图像样式转移和空间路由精度.
